signature: Publisher documents unsigned binaries; SHA256 values are GitHub release asset digests, not a signature or malware verdict.
telemetry: Mandatory machine identifier, package identifiers, latency/errors and GitHub organization. Shared shell aliases wrap npm, bun and uv when the guarded launcher is installed, as explicitly requested. Custom/private registries are unsupported.
ca_source: Pinned Mozilla CA bundle cacert-2026-11-05.pem from curl.se (scripts/security/artifacts.json ca-bundle), installed at ~/.local/share/dotfiles-ca/cacert.pem
embedded_runtime: Node 24.21.0; bundled roots include incident-excluded emSign ECC G3. Guarded launcher disables bundled trust and uses the pinned clean PEM snapshot.
